question: What custom began in Israel because of Jephthah's daughter?
options: Each year the young women of Israel went out for four days to commemorate her
A feast was held at Shiloh every spring
A stone pillar was set up at Mizpah
A town was named after her
explanation: From this came the Israelite tradition that each year the young women went out for four days to commemorate the daughter of Jephthah.
